scope: Stopped before prediction output files were written.
cause: The independent expected waveform formula performed intermediate arithmetic in float32, while the frozen physics transform computes in float64 and casts the final waveform to float32.
resolution: Compute the independent physical equations in float64 then cast once to float32. The same block then agrees within 4.6e-15 raw units; waveform comparison tolerance returns to 1e-4.
